chunks: Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Abi Basir, from one of the two (Imams) عليهما السلام, who said:
I said: regarding the saying of Allah, the Exalted,
"Retaliation is prescribed for you in cases of the slain: the free for the free, the slave for the slave, and the female for the female."
He said: He said, "A free person is not killed for a slave; rather, he is beaten severely and made to pay the price of the slave."

key_terms.الْقِصَاصُ: legal retaliation in cases of unlawful killing
key_terms.ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ: the monetary value of the slave

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a free person kills a slave according to this hadith and the verse on qisas?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the ruling related to the Qur'anic verse on qisas in cases of killing. It states that a free person is not subject to execution for killing a slave, but is instead severely punished and held financially liable for the slave's value.
